authorization: User requested pilot accounting and table-model two-stage scan; prior A1/A2 queues remain unchanged.
pilot_scope: Resource-only overhead under ideal RX and feedback channel estimates; no finite-pilot estimation-error simulation and no claim of nonideal receiver performance.

channel.feedback_content: Only the registered quantized SNR bin; no additional ACK/NACK or free source-adaptive configuration bits.
channel.TX_observations: Source-derived expected quality, mean SNR, frozen public policies, and paid quantized SNR feedback; no instantaneous h or noise realization.
channel.CSI: Ideal receiver estimate; integration coordinate is only used by the channel/feedback model, not exposed to the transmitter decision beyond its bin.

measured_headers.first_68: Existing real header success/failure/undetected probability curve.
measured_headers.second_68: Same existing curve, conditionally independent noise given common h.
measured_headers.second_16: MISSING_HEADER_PHY; never rescale the 68-symbol header curve.
measured_headers.second_0: No second header; exact configuration is inferred from the paid first policy-tree ID and public feedback bin.

ideal_controls.scope: Paid, error-free controls including first header; overhead diagnostic only, not a physical result.
ideal_controls.second_0_16_68: Always correct, all specified symbols charged.

methods.FIXED: All frozen original 4041 resource-feasible profiles plus compatible measured supplemental layouts; no feedback.
methods.QCSI: Same strong profile catalog after paying pilots, feedback and first 68-symbol header; source-independent policy per quantized bin.
methods.TWO_STAGE: First complete m4/m5/m6 prefix; exactly matched existing PHY; one quantized-SNR feedback then suffix or STOP. All first-PHY candidates and registered quantizers searched on construction800.
methods.TWO_STAGE_C8: Matched to population TWO_STAGE first PHY and quantizer. Up to 8 public suffix-policy trees chosen from construction800 per-source optimal trees plus the uniform tree; source-informed tree choice occurs before CSI feedback.

content_dictionary.greedy: Maximize construction800 mean of per-source maximum expected quality; stop when marginal gain is nonpositive.
content_dictionary.initial_header: 12-bit paid first header identifies the selected whole public tree, including second-stage configuration for each feedback bin.
content_dictionary.first_phase_duration: Fixed/public within each cell; feedback timing does not depend on successful header decoding.
content_dictionary.internal200: May choose among already frozen 8 trees using its own source qualities at transmission, but never constructs the dictionary or selects global parameters.

search.candidate_PHY: Exact payload bits, modulation, coded length, rate-matching layout and CRC compatibility only. Frozen original body catalog plus the 15 physically qualified supplemental configurations. No old R-action pruning.
search.terminal_states: All available registered Q states reachable by an exactly matching suffix payload; no truncation to whole-scale states.
search.source_split: Reuse parent C/split.json exactly: SHA256 compact JSON [C/SOURCE_SPLIT,2026100501,source_id]; 800 construction and 200 internal verification.
search.global_selection: All policies, splits and other global choices use construction800 only; retain each requested grid cell. Never pick a headline from internal200.
search.tie_break: Deterministic stable registered action order; exact implementation recorded in source snapshot.
search.main_point_selection: At pilot16/feedback16/header68/measured_headers, choose feedback bit count and first split by construction800 for each SNR. Other grid cells remain visible.

probability_model.interpolation: Linear in dB with constant endpoint tails, inherited working assumption.
probability_model.integration: Joint conditional products at same h, split at table knots and feedback thresholds; never multiply independently averaged packet probabilities.
probability_model.undetected_state: Absorbing unknown state U; point quality 0, bounds [-1,1]. Header wrong-accept and body undetected error never map to a clean cached Q.
probability_model.gray_state: Cached original gray quality when no correct trusted prefix is available and no U event.
probability_model.second_failure: Retain first trusted prefix after detected failure; suffix ignored unless first prefix is trusted.
probability_model.source_payload_applicability: Inherited iid-scrambled-payload BLER model has not been validated as a physical result for this new two-stage protocol.

resource_accounting.units: Complex channel symbols, including reverse feedback as a symbol-equivalent cost.
resource_accounting.two_stage: pilot+68+body1+feedback+header2+body2<=1024 for every public tree branch; STOP has no second header/body.
resource_accounting.mean_power: Inherited equal mean energy convention; 16QAM not advertised as per-frame equal-energy.
resource_accounting.metadata: Public codebooks and bin partitions frozen before internal verification; selected tree ID paid within first 12 bits, verified codebook size<=4096 per public operating setting.

verification.bootstrap_unit: One of the fixed internal200 sources; paired expected-model scores.
verification.interval_scope: Descriptive variation across sources, conditional on frozen probability/quality model. Does not include BLER estimation uncertainty and is not a measured-link confidence interval.
verification.independent_metric: Only reuse aligned cached metrics where available; unavailable metrics are explicitly marked, no new neural evaluation.
